[IALC.6.3] `DS_ALLOC_WEAK` is the default for every artifact. The
from-source build and the prebuilt archive both carry the weak wrapper, so
any consumer can override at link without a recompile. A build that wants
the zero-indirection, byte-identical-to-libc form sets
`DS_ALLOC_MODE=DS_ALLOC_MACRO` explicitly ([IALC.10.3]).
